id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b8cc: "...Oh, are you passing the sluice gate? You have your own ship! How enviable!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b9cc: "I came to this town to see Sir Diego, and he'd just returned the other day. Perfect timing.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ba84: "He got a minor injury on the way back... but still agreed to see guests. Sir Diego is truly big-hearted.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb98: "Sir Diego, who was injured, has fully recovered and is devoting himself to training knights, I hear.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bd28: "I want to be a fine knight, so I came to Puerto Valor, where hero Lord Hendrik trained.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bdf4: "I swore to my family I'd be a knight. A knight never goes back on his word, so I can't turn back now.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bf3c: "...Wow, going to the open sea, you're brave. I hear the open sea has many unexplored lands.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c00c: "It must be thrilling for fearless adventurers. I pray for good fortune on your journey.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c130: "Sir Diego, who went to Heliodor, has returned!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c1ac: "But he was injured fighting violent monsters. He's resting in his room, I hear.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c2bc: "Sir Diego, who went to Heliodor, has returned! I hear he healed and is training knights!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c390: "Now I can join Sir Diego's school and train to be a first-rate knight! All right, I'll do my best!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c558: "This is Puerto Valor, town of flowers and sea breeze. Famous for clear blue seas and pure white beaches.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c848: "This is Puerto Valor, town of flowers and sea breeze. Famous for clear blue seas and pure white beaches.

id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c628: "...A merchant with a rainbow branch? Come to think of it, I saw a merchant with such a thing head to Sir Diego's mansion.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c720: "Sir Diego's mansion is down the stairs and to the left. It's a big building, so you'll spot it.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c918: "It's also known as a town of the great sluice gate. The sight of ships to the open sea passing under it is magnificent.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cb74: "It's also known as a town of the great sluice gate. The sight of ships to the open sea passing under it is magnificent.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc98: "...What, you're going through the sluice gate? The open sea has all kinds of towns. Safe travels!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cdac: "Passing through the sluice gate, wow! The open sea has all kinds of towns. Safe travels!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cfa8: "But rumor says a black sun appeared over Gallopolis across the sea... The whole town is bewildered.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d1a4: "Oh, Sir Diego's injury healed, and he trains knights at the training ground by day. I'm so happy to see him well.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d448: "This town has ties to Heliodor. Promising young Heliodor men come here to train as knights.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d680: "This town has ties to Heliodor. Promising young Heliodor men come here to train as knights.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d530: "The young men learn swordsmanship under Sir Diego. If recognized, they can become Heliodor soldiers.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d768: "The young men learn swordsmanship under Sir Diego. If recognized, they can become Heliodor soldiers.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d8b8: "He's going around saying he saw a march of demons beyond the landslide to the northwest.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d96c: "Everyone's already scared of the Dark One, he needn't tell lies that worry them more!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|da50: "Who are these people! Could they be the ones marching in the western lands...? Then the rumor was true!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|db04: "...But though they dress strangely, unlike the rumors, they don't seem that bad.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dc1c: "Young master Goliath, missing since leaving town a dozen-plus years ago, came back, and Sir Diego is well!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dde4: "Young master Goliath, missing since leaving town a dozen-plus years ago, came back, and Sir Diego is well!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dd00: "Still, I can't believe Sir Diego's son is the leader of this parade!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dec8: "Still, I can't believe Sir Diego's son is the leader of this parade!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|df90: "The parade folks have blended into this town completely. Now everyone loves them.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e05c: "The parade folks have blended into this town completely. Now everyone loves them.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e128: "Since the black sun appeared over Gallopolis, everyone seems unsettled. We must stay calm.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e244: "Since the black sun appeared over Gallopolis, everyone seems unsettled. We must stay calm.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e4a0: "You know, in the hotel... there's a lady who trades mini medals for rare treasures!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e67c: "You know, in the hotel... there's a lady who trades mini medals for rare treasures!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e538: "I want mini medals too. Where can I find them?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e5d4: "Mumble mumble, big brother... Please come back...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e714: "That lady graduated from a girls-only school surrounded by mountains! I want to study there too!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e804: "Waaah, my big brother dressed up funny and went somewhere! Sniff.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e8b8: "My missing big brother came back! I'm so, so happy... waaah, waaah.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|e984: "Yay, Sir Diego came back! You know, you know, Sir Diego is kind and so strong!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ec08: "We came from the far northern land of snow. Everything here is fresh and never boring.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|edac: "We came from the far northern land of snow. Everything here is fresh and never boring.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|eca8: "Look there. The sea sparkles. The breeze feels nice too. Best feeling ever.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ee4c: "Look there. A girl's dancing on the beach. The night breeze feels nice too. Best feeling ever.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ef5c: "We came here as tourists but can't go home. Ending our lives in this beautiful town might not be bad.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f050: "Ah, the world's ending. I'm happy to have tasted the southern climate with Grandma at the last...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f148: "Grandma, it's getting noisy. I'm hard of hearing so can't hear well, but is the Reaper finally coming?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f224: "Those folks were really kind to us. Cheerful and great fun. I thought them demons, but maybe angels.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f338: "Those folks were really kind to us. Cheerful and great fun. I thought them demons, but maybe angels.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f468: "We came from the far northern land of snow. Still, glad we came. Everything is fresh and this town never bores.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f658: "We came from the far northern land of snow. Still, glad we came. Everything is fresh and this town never bores.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f544: "Just the other day, the southeast sky flashed black. I've never seen that back home.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f734: "Just the other day, the southeast sky flashed black. I've never seen that back home.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|f98c: "We're old and don't have long, so we came all the way from the northern snowland to taste the southern sea once.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fb68: "We're old and don't have long, so we came all the way from the northern snowland to taste the southern sea once.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fa70: "Grandpa's so giddy, moved by every little thing. It was worth the leap to come.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fc4c: "Our homeland, the Kingdom of Sniflheim, is far north across the open sea. Please stop by if you like.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fd60: "Our homeland, the Kingdom of Sniflheim, is far north across the open sea. Please stop by if you like.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|fe90: "...The day Yggdrasil fell we were looking at the sea like this. Just recalling it tightens my chest.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ff74: "Having lost Yggdrasil's protection, what should we believe in...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1005: "It's noisy. I don't know what's happening... but I'll be with Grandpa till the end.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1017: "Grandpa has fallen for the parade folks and talks of nothing else.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1034: "Grandpa has fallen for the parade folks and talks of nothing else.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1021: "The world's still wrapped in darkness, but thanks to them a ray of light fell on the town... I feel so.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|103e: "The world's still wrapped in darkness, but thanks to them a ray of light fell on the town... I feel so.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|104f: "I'm truly happy to see this beautiful sea again with Grandpa.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|105c: "I'm truly happy to see this beautiful sea again with Grandpa.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1069: "Just the other day an ominous wind blew into town from the southeast sky. I'd never felt such a wind...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|108e: "On this building's second floor stays a stylish gentleman. He complimented my clothes.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ab: "On this building's second floor stays a stylish gentleman. He complimented my clothes.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|109c: "And he even taught me a lovely recommended outfit! You might take his advice too!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10b8: "And he even taught me a lovely recommended outfit! You might take his advice too!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10c8: "I was attacked by monsters in the west and saved by mysterious dazzling people! They're the saviors protecting the world!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10d9: "...But everyone thinks I dreamed it and nobody believes me. I'm not lying!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10ea: "These people are my saviors! They saved me when monsters attacked me in the west!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|10f8: "It's been a while, but they're still thrilling and wonderful! As expected of saviors!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1106: "The parade folks who saved me... still thrilling and wonderful! As expected of saviors!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1116: "The parade folks who saved me... still thrilling and wonderful! As expected of saviors!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1125: "I hear a black sun appeared over Gallopolis! Scary... but with Sir Diego here, the town is surely safe!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1134: "I hear a black sun appeared over Gallopolis! Scary... but with Sir Diego here, the town is surely safe!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1151: "When I was little and visited Heliodor, I saw Princess Jade.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|117e: "When I was little and visited Heliodor, I saw Princess Jade.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|115d: "Cute as a fairy tale sprite. I thought she'd grow even more beautiful than her late mother, the Queen.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|118a: "Cute as a fairy tale sprite. I thought she'd grow even more beautiful than her late mother, the Queen.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|116c: "But Princess Jade died in Dundrasil's tragedy sixteen years ago. I feel so sorry for the King.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|119a: "But Princess Jade died in Dundrasil's tragedy sixteen years ago. I feel so sorry for the King.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11a8: "Time seems to flow slowly in this town. Getting away from the city sometimes to relax isn't bad.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11b8: "Time seems to flow slowly in this town. Getting away from the city sometimes to relax isn't bad.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11c9: "Thinking a black sun lies over the southeast sea, the calm sea looks eerie. I hope it's not the calm before the storm...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11de: "Thinking a black sun lies over the southeast sea, the calm sea looks eerie. I hope it's not the calm before the storm...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|11fd: "The great eastern nation Heliodor had a young princess named Jade.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1207: "But sixteen years ago, in the tragedy of Dundrasil, on the day of the Four Nations Summit, Princess Jade vanished.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1218: "It's believed the fearsome Luminary, the Darkspawn, took her life, but what happened in Dundrasil remains a mystery.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|122d: "They say the world has six brightly shining orbs.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1234: "The six orbs were kept by six nations, but half of them fell, and their whereabouts are unknown.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1247: "Whatever happens, as long as Sir Diego is in this town, you're surely safe here.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1260: "Traveler, on the road north from this town, there's a sheer valley west. Have you been there?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|129d: "Traveler, on the road north from this town, there's a sheer valley west. Have you been there?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1271: "Ha ha, that's understandable. It's a very hard-to-find place.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12af: "Ha ha, that's understandable. It's a very hard-to-find place.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|127e: "Oh, you found that place. You're quite a seasoned traveler.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12bb: "Oh, you found that place. You're quite a seasoned traveler.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1285: "Rumor says beyond the sheer valley is a strange school only girls can enter. If true, I'd send my daughter.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12c3: "Rumor says beyond the sheer valley is a strange school only girls can enter. If true, I'd send my daughter.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12db: "The rumored black sun is said to be enormous. If something happens to it, no escape would save us...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12fd: "The rumored black sun is said to be enormous. If something happens to it, no escape would save us...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|12ea: "More dangerous is being attacked by violent monsters while fleeing. Staying here is better.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|130b: "More dangerous is being attacked by violent monsters while fleeing. Staying here is better.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1325: "My kids learned a weird make-believe game... I should teach them properly how scary the Darkspawn is.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1335: "The kids are tired from play and asleep, so I'm finally alone with my husband. At last, time for just the two of us.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1346: "When I told my kids the Luminary's Star fell in the Gallopolis region, they got excited... I must teach them it's dangerous.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1358: "A black sun appeared over Gallopolis, apparently... I was discussing with my husband whether to flee as far as possible.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1371: "Eek, help! Lord Hendrik! Lord Jasper! The Darkspawn is chasing me!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1382: "Yay! The star fell! It fell, it fell!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1399: "Rawr, I'm the Darkspawn! I'll eat you up!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13a8: "The Luminary's Star fell! A star falling is amazing!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13ce: "Believe it or not, we're Heliodor soldiers. We're treating ourselves to a vacation for all our hard work.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13eb: "Believe it or not, we're Heliodor soldiers. We're treating ourselves to a vacation for all our hard work.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13da: "But once this leave ends, we'll surely be dragged out to hunt the Darkspawn. I wish the vacation lasted forever.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|13f7: "But once this leave ends, we'll surely be dragged out to hunt the Darkspawn. I wish the vacation lasted forever.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1409: "I came from Heliodor on a trip, but with these times I'm helping guard the town to be of use.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1417: "...I hear my homeland Heliodor fell, so I've nowhere to return. Guarding here is all I can do.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1429: "Who are those flashy people...! Could they be the rumored demonic group marching in the west...!?
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1437: "...But though flashy, they look like ordinary humans. I expected something nastier.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1449: "The town's dancer Ochori has returned! She'll do dance shows on the night beach again like before!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1456: "Lately it's been all sad news, so being excited like this is a treat! Maybe thanks to the parade folks!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1465: "Whoaaa, Ochori! Seeing Ochori dance like before is the best! Ha ha!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1473: "Sir Diego has fully recovered! Thanks to the damned Dark One falling and Yggdrasil reviving!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1484: "A black sun appeared over Gallopolis, but little folks like us can't do anything. Let's enjoy this town while we live!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1496: "A black sun appeared over Gallopolis, but little folks like us can't do anything. Let's enjoy this town while we live!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14bd: "The Darkspawn fleeing Heliodor showed up in Gondolia and shook off General Jasper's pursuit.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14cb: "If even Lord Jasper let him slip, who could catch him... I don't think I could.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14db: "Whoaaa! Ochori's dance, the best! Ah, I'm glad I'm alive!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14e8: "After passing the Solcha Canal to the open sea, follow the coast north to find Sniflheim, thriving in magic research.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|14f8: "I think Sniflheim has a beautiful princess. I'd love to meet her once.
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1508: "I saw it! Really! West of this town, a procession of terrifying demon-like people!
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1516: "They played weird music and danced. Surely the fate of humans who sold their souls to the Dark One. Ah, how scary...
id./param/region/r010.pack|npc_ie.bxon|1528: "Th-these are them! The people marching and dancing in the western land! My eyes were right! See! See!

tm.「向こうの水門の下を流れる ソルッチャ運河は\n ここソルティコと メダチャット: "The Solcha Canal under that sluice gate connects Puerto Valor, Medalberg, and even the open sea.
tm.「ソルッチャ運河は ロトゼタシアの門戸とも\n 呼ばれてましてね。この川のおかげ: "The Solcha Canal is called Erdrea's gateway. Thanks to this river, countries of the open and inner seas trade freely.
tm.「……おや あなた 水門を通るんですか？\n 自分の船を お持ちなんですね！\n: "...Oh, are you passing the sluice gate? You have your own ship! How enviable!
tm.「ジエーゴさまに会うため この町に来たのですが\n ちょうど先日 お帰りになった: "I came to this town to see Sir Diego, and he'd just returned the other day. Perfect timing.
tm.「帰る道中に 軽いケガを負ったそうですが……\n それでも 客人に お会いしてく: "He got a minor injury on the way back... but still agreed to see guests. Sir Diego is truly big-hearted.
tm.「ケガを負われていた ジエーゴさまは\n 今は すっかり お元気になられて\n: "Sir Diego, who was injured, has fully recovered and is devoting himself to training knights, I hear.
tm.「僕は 立派な騎士になりたくて\n 英雄グレイグさまが 修行を積んだという\n: "I want to be a fine knight, so I came to Puerto Valor, where hero Lord Hendrik trained.
tm.「家族には騎士になると誓って 家を出たからね。\n 騎士に二言はない…という言葉: "I swore to my family I'd be a knight. A knight never goes back on his word, so I can't turn back now.
tm.「……へえ 外海に出るなんて\n キミたちって 勇気があるんだね。\n 外海には: "...Wow, going to the open sea, you're brave. I hear the open sea has many unexplored lands.
tm.「命知らずの 冒険者にとっては\n さぞ 魅力的な場所にちがいないだろうね。\n: "It must be thrilling for fearless adventurers. I pray for good fortune on your journey.
tm.「デルカダール王国へ 出かけていたという\n ジエーゴさまが 帰ってきたようなん: "Sir Diego, who went to Heliodor, has returned!
tm.「だけど なんでも 凶暴化した魔物と戦って\n ケガを負ってしまったそうでね。\: "But he was injured fighting violent monsters. He's resting in his room, I hear.
tm.「デルカダール王国へ 出かけていたという\n ジエーゴさまが 帰ってきたようなん: "Sir Diego, who went to Heliodor, has returned! I hear he healed and is training knights!
